subject.title: feat(feeds): refresh and manage followed publishers

question: Should OpenClaw own signed publisher-feed following, persistence, scheduling, and gateway RPCs in core, or should this capability be delivered through a ClawHub/plugin boundary with only generic core seams?
rationale: The branch introduces a broad optional capability across CLI, gateway, storage, remote transport, and trust configuration; repository guidance prefers plugins for optional capabilities, but the available evidence does not prove whether current plugin seams are insufficient.

options.title: Keep it out of core
options.body: Pause this core implementation and define or use a plugin-owned publisher-feed integration, adding only a demonstrated generic core seam if one is missing.

options.title: Approve a narrow core exception
options.body: Accept core ownership only with an explicit durable API, storage, security, documentation, upgrade, and rollout contract.

recommendation.title: Keep it out of core
recommendation.body: Pause this core implementation and define or use a plugin-owned publisher-feed integration, adding only a demonstrated generic core seam if one is missing.

likelyOwner.reason: Likely repository-level decision owner for an exception to the stated core-versus-plugin direction.
